content.title: Flat Character Type Carousel | Repetition, Depth, and Wordmark Return
content.summary: Carry one flat character identity through a compact name field, silhouette verification, circular type, an extruded word track, single-word action cards and shallow grid spaces. Preserve silhouette, palette and face marks across scale and depth changes, then return from detail fragments to the full character and original name mark.

quick_start.input_format: stylized character with stable silhouette, palette, face marks and compact original name field + at least four genuinely different layout modules + one new short word and one character action per word-bearing module + identity preserved through flat, macro and shallow 3D formats + explicit repetition or verification + return to full character and original name field
quick_start.recommended_input: An adult-proportioned robot librarian with a cream chassis, teal visor and red spine light crosses INDEX, SORT, STACK and RETURN modules, repeats through silhouette and word-track checks, then settles inside the complete FOLIO book mark.
required_anchors: Establish one stylized character with stable silhouette, palette, face marks and a compact original name field.
Use at least four modules with genuinely different layout logic while limiting each to one new short word or field.
Preserve identity through flat cards, macro scale and shallow 3D space, including one repetition or verification phase.
Return from fragments or details to the full character and original name field for a stable hold.
usage_steps: Replace the example subject, setting, and surface details with an original concept.
Keep every required anchor and Creative DNA invariant causally visible.
Choose the MiniMax H3 or Seedance 2.0 prompt and fill only the declared variable slots.
Check duration, event order, camera continuity, sound, and anti-copy constraints before generation.
applicable_scope: Carry one flat character identity through a compact name field, silhouette verification, circular type, an extruded word track, single-word action cards and shallow grid spaces. Preserve silhouette, palette and face marks across scale and depth changes, then return from detail fragments to the full character and original name mark.
Original 4–15 second concepts that can preserve every required anchor.
MiniMax H3 or Seedance 2.0 projects that need a reusable causal video structure.
not_suitable_for: Requests that copy the source identity, setting, props, dialogue, or shot order.
Concepts that cannot show all required anchors inside the target duration.
Long-form exposition or unrelated multi-location stories without a compact causal chain.

creative_dna.mechanism: Establish one original stylized character through stable silhouette, palette, face marks and a compact original name field. Rotate through at least four graphic modules that change layout logic—such as triptych, circular text, extruded word track, single-word action card and shallow grid space—while introducing no more than one new short word or identity field per module. Bind each word-bearing module to one readable character action and preserve the same identity anchors through scale, flatness and depth changes. Include one explicit repetition or identity-verification phase, then return from detail fragments to the full character and the original name field. The reusable mechanism is identity-locked module rotation, action-to-word binding, recurring graphic anchors and character-to-wordmark closure—not the source penguin, crest, vest, stripes, words, logo, palette, layouts, choreography, watermark, creator identity or timing.

invariants.rule: Establish one stylized character with stable silhouette, palette, face marks and a compact original name field.
invariants.purpose: Provides enough identity anchors for aggressive graphic variation.
invariants.ablation_failure: A single color or generic body shape cannot sustain continuity.

invariants.rule: Use at least four modules with genuinely different layout logic while limiting each to one new short word or field.
invariants.purpose: Creates variety without sacrificing reading speed.
invariants.ablation_failure: Palette-only changes add no structural progression; dense copy becomes noise.

invariants.rule: Bind every word-bearing module to one readable character action on or through the typography.
invariants.purpose: Connects the performer to the information system.
invariants.ablation_failure: A floating character beside unrelated text produces no causal design.

invariants.rule: Preserve identity through flat cards, macro scale and shallow 3D space, including one repetition or verification phase.
invariants.purpose: Proves the same character survives format changes.
invariants.ablation_failure: Unmotivated redesign or missing verification makes continuity uncertain.

invariants.rule: Return from fragments or details to the full character and original name field for a stable hold.
invariants.purpose: Closes the module carousel into one identity statement.
invariants.ablation_failure: Ending on an abstract insert leaves the character and title unresolved.

slots.name: lead_subject
slots.constraint: An original stable subject or pair with a readable role.

slots.name: setting
slots.constraint: A new setting with fixed spatial anchors and no source-specific surface.

slots.name: escalation_variable
slots.constraint: One causal variable that changes through visible stages.

slots.name: performance_rule
slots.constraint: A restrained acting or motion rule that keeps the mechanism legible.

slots.name: camera_grammar
slots.constraint: An information order that proves each state without copying source shot boundaries.

slots.name: payoff
slots.constraint: A clean final physical, informational or social consequence.

slots.name: sound_family
slots.constraint: An original hierarchy of diegetic cues; no unsupported source-audio claim.

anti_copy_exclusions: the source penguin-like character, pink crest and striped limbs, green padded vest, face and proportions
the source lowercase name mark and all visible source words, circular text and microcopy
the source green-pink-black-white palette, yin-yang eye graphic, silhouettes, grids and exact card layouts
the source repeated rolling characters, word-track movement, poses, transitions, camera path and 13.7-second timing
the source creator identity, Lil Pudgys identity, MiniMax H3 claim, watermark and branding
